compatibility.title: Which Fiat Models Use the 55263087?
compatibility.intro: The 55263087 is the entry-level 1.0-litre 3-cylinder naturally aspirated variant of Fiat’s modern FireFly engine family. It was introduced to replace older 1.2-litre and 0.9-litre TwinAir units, delivering improved fuel efficiency, lower emissions, and mild-hybrid assistance for urban driving.

costGuide.title: Fiat 55263087 Engine Replacement Cost (UK)
costGuide.labourLine: Fitting a 55263087 typically takes 6-8 hours at £65-£85/hr (independent) - confirm exact labour and mild-hybrid system recalibration requirements when comparing quotes.
paragraphs: The Fiat 55263087 engine replacement cost is generally low due to the high production volume and modular design of the FireFly family. However, because this is a mild-hybrid unit, the 12V belt-driven starter generator (BSG) must be handled and recalibrated correctly during removal, which can slightly influence labour time. For a complete breakdown of labour and parts, see our full reconditioned engine cost guide.

failures.title: Fiat 55263087 Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Timing Belt Degradation (Oil Contamination)
items.whatHappens: The FireFly engine uses a timing belt that runs in an oil bath. If the incorrect oil specification is used or service intervals are extended, the belt can prematurely degrade. This sheds rubber debris that can block the oil pickup strainer, leading to catastrophic oil starvation and bearing failure.
items.repairVsReplace: Preventative timing belt replacement is inexpensive and highly recommended. However, if oil starvation has already occurred, a full Fiat 55263087 engine replacement is the only safe and reliable option.

items.title: Mild-Hybrid System (BSG) Faults
items.whatHappens: The 12V Belt-driven Starter Generator can occasionally develop electrical faults or bearing wear. This triggers dashboard warning lights, prevents the engine from auto-starting, or causes rough idling when the hybrid system attempts to assist.
items.repairVsReplace: This is typically resolved by replacing the BSG unit and updating the ECU software, which is far more economical than a full engine swap and does not require engine removal.

failures.goodYearsLine: The 55263087 is a relatively modern and robust design. The vast majority of reported issues stem from missed servicing (specifically the use of incorrect oil specifications) rather than inherent design flaws .

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the 55263087
variants.intro: The 55263087 is a Specific engine code, representing the 1.0-litre naturally aspirated 3-cylinder mild-hybrid variant of Fiat's FireFly family. It is most commonly confused with the older, naturally aspirated 1.2-litre Fire engine or the 0.9-litre TwinAir turbocharged unit. The engine code is stamped on a machined pad on the engine block, typically visible near the oil filter housing or on the front timing cover. It will also be explicitly listed in section D.2 of your V5C logbook.

relatives.description: The older naturally aspirated 1.2L and turbocharged 0.9L engines were replaced by the 55263087 to meet stricter emissions standards and introduce mild-hybrid technology, though they lack the oil-bath timing belt design.
The turbocharged variant of the same FireFly family, producing higher output for the Fiat 500X and Tipo, featuring different turbo plumbing and ECU mapping.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement 55263087 - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used 55263087 can be a viable budget option for low-mileage city cars, provided it comes with documented proof of strict adherence to the correct low-SAPS oil specification to protect the oil-bath timing belt. The primary risk is hidden oil starvation damage from prior belt degradation. Learn more about sourcing used engines.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: A properly reconditioned 55263087 is the recommended choice for most owners. A reputable rebuild will replace the timing belt, water pump, and thoroughly inspect the mild-hybrid BSG system, effectively resetting the engine's reliability clock for another 100,000 miles. Explore reconditioned engines.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified only if the engine has suffered catastrophic oil starvation due to a degraded timing belt, requiring new pistons, bearings, and a refreshed block. An upgraded rebuild ensures all internal clearances are restored to factory specification. See options for rebuilt engines.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Our network of vetted UK specialists offers comprehensive supply and fit packages for the 55263087, complete with nationwide delivery, robust warranty coverage, and necessary hybrid system recalibration. Check our supply and fit services.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: The 55263087 is typically found in modern Fiat 500 and Panda models valued between £6,000 and £12,000 . With reconditioned replacement costs starting around £1,000, the investment represents a small fraction of the vehicle's overall value, making engine replacement a highly rational and financially sound decision compared to writing off a modern, efficient city car.

items.answer: A reconditioned Fiat 55263087 engine costs between £1,000 and £1,800 for supply only, or £1,415 to £2,485 fully fitted by an independent specialist. items.question: What is the most common problem with the Fiat 55263087 engine?
items.answer: The most critical documented issue with the 55263087 is timing belt degradation due to the belt running in an oil bath. If incorrect oil is used or service intervals are extended, the belt sheds rubber debris that can block the oil pickup strainer, leading to catastrophic oil starvation. Preventative timing belt replacement is inexpensive, but if oil starvation has occurred, a full unit swap is required.

items.question: Which Fiat models use the 55263087 engine?
items.answer: The 55263087 is fitted exclusively to the mild-hybrid variants of the modern Fiat 500 (312 facelift) and Fiat Panda (319 facelift) from 2020 onwards. It produces approximately 70 hp (51 kW) and features a 12V belt-driven starter generator (BSG) for mild-hybrid assistance.
bullets: It produces approximately 70 hp (51 kW) and features a 12V belt-driven starter generator (BSG).
It serves as the entry-level, naturally aspirated 1.0-litre 3-cylinder engine in the FireFly family.

items.question: Should I buy a used or reconditioned 55263087 engine?
items.answer: A reconditioned 55263087 is strongly recommended over a used unit due to the age-related degradation risk of the oil-bath timing belt. A proper reconditioning process replaces the timing belt and water pump, and thoroughly inspects the mild-hybrid BSG system, whereas used units may hide impending belt degradation or oil starvation damage.

Used units may hide impending belt degradation or oil starvation damage from prior incorrect oil use.

items.question: How do I know if my car has the 55263087 and not a similar code?
items.answer: You can confirm your engine code by checking the machined pad on the engine block near the oil filter housing, the V5C logbook (section D.2), or by entering your registration above. It is commonly confused with the older 1.2L Fire or the 0.9L TwinAir, and fitting the wrong engine will result in severe ECU mapping conflicts and mild-hybrid system incompatibilities.
